frame: 0-1 minimap frame: origin at the top-left corner of the minimap image, u to the right (west to east), v down (north to south), both 0 to 1 across the full image. Positions are team-normalized so the smoking team spawn is at the bottom (bottom-left on Okinawa): north-spawn teams are mirrored north-south (v -> 1 - v) on Hotspot, Loop, Land of Fire, Mountain Range, Sleeping Giant and Sea of Fortune, and across the NW-SE diagonal ((u, v) -> (v, u)) on Okinawa, whose spawns are NE and SW. The mirror is applied to positions only: the frame is the minimap image in its native orientation, so the images need no flipping. Lengths: radius_u, ru and rv are fractions of the image width. An ellipse angle_deg is the rotation of the ru axis clockwise on screen from the u axis (as SVG rotate).

spots.subject: destroyer smoke, first 5 minutes
spots.notes: Mean-shift cluster (2 km) of all early destroyer smoke centres on the map, both groups; the ellipse is 2 standard deviations. Cap won counts only smokes whose contested cap was not already ours. Links are Top 6 smokes nearest the centre.

spots.label: west lane between caps A and B (wide)
spots.subject: smokes with a death in them, all classes
spots.notes: Mean-shift cluster (2.5 km) of the centres of smokes, any class, in which the smoker or a covered teammate was lost. The ellipse is 2 standard deviations. deaths_per_100_in_ellipse counts every smoke laid inside the ellipse. Association only: deaths go with being behind and with enemy radar (Module 5). Wide: read it as a zone.
